title: ChromaDB: Embeddings and Vector Databases in Python
description: Learn what embeddings and vector databases are, then store, query, and filter text with ChromaDB in Python and use it to give an LLM context.
summary: ChromaDB is an open-source vector database built for applications that use large language models (LLMs). LLMs like the ones behind OpenAI’s ChatGPT can reason about natural language processing (NLP) problems remarkably well, but on their own, they only know what appeared in their training data.
takeaways: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) uses a vector database like ChromaDB to find relevant documents and pass them to an LLM as context.
In this tutorial, you’ll learn the concepts behind embeddings and vector databases, and then you’ll put them to work with ChromaDB in Python.
Embeddings are dense vectors that capture the meaning of words and text, and you can create them in Python with spaCy and SentenceTransformers.
